# SKILL.md Validator

> Free online SKILL.md validator and security checker for Agent Skills files. Paste a SKILL.md file to check its frontmatter against the official spec, estimate the token cost it adds to every session, and scan for risky patterns — 100% in the browser, nothing is uploaded.

## How it works

1. Open https://skillmdvalidator.com/
2. Paste your SKILL.md content (or drop the file) into the validator
3. Get instant results: format errors, security warnings, best-practice suggestions, token estimate
4. Fix the issues and re-check until the report is clean

## Pricing

Free. No sign-up, no account, no paywall. The tool runs entirely in your browser.

## Alternatives

- skills-ref (the official reference implementation from agentskills.io): a library for programmatic validation, not a web tool
- LOLSkills / Skill Guard web scanners: security-only scanning, no format validation against the official spec

This tool combines format validation + security scan + multi-agent compatibility table + 100% local processing in one page.
